findings.description: Design decisions D8 (module name / atlas_tree.py helper) and D9 (refusal list) are referenced by tasks 1.1, 1.3, 2.2, 2.5 in tasks.md and by packages wp-atlas-tree and wp-skill in work-packages.yaml, but design.md only defines decisions up through D7. Neither D8 nor D9 is documented in design.md.

Task 2.5 in tasks.md outlines writing references/grounding.md including handling tree tool failures and mapping them to 'graph check failed', but omits skill-workflow scenario 'Tree tool failure after fresh check' from its Spec scenarios list, despite enumerating all other grounding scenarios.

In session-log.md under '## Phase: Plan Review (2026-09-16)', '### Next Steps' is placed ahead of '### Decisions (round 2)', and decisions from Plan Review rounds 3 and 4 (which bumped plan_revision to 6) are missing from the log.

In .review-ledger/ledger.json, item 13 is marked as status 'retired' with retired_reason 'plan-review-adjudication-round-4', which conflicts with reviews/parked-disagreements.json where item 13 is tracked as an active parked disagreement.
